rules: management revision scoped to manager session, independent of SDK counters and Diffusion transport inputRevision
pairContentHash binds both original file hashes
mode=single-pair; composition requires separate approved future schema
one active side instance per high/low with manager-assigned instance identity; two registered pairs do not require four active instances
new local plan invalidates its side and requires new manager snapshot; cannot mutate a running generation snapshot
both high and low readiness required before common snapshot publication, not simultaneous session residency
commit(stage) and publishSnapshot are distinct; every generation request checks pinned snapshot hash
transport map binds protocol/session/job/inputRevision to management snapshot; no equality assumption between counters
scope=partial-projection/completeAdapter=false can publish only a labelled diagnostic state, never generation-ready full snapshot

important: no READY after only high succeeds
old running generation must finish or be explicitly cancelled before config switch activation
failed low before publication discards both staged candidates and preserves old active descriptor
if RAM budget required dropping old session, recover from saved original descriptor and block admission until validated
old rollback must compare expected active token before restore; otherwise cleanup only

commitGuard: check cancellation and live candidate ownership
no async gap between final authoritative check and atomic publication; cross-worker requires authoritative owner CAS/ack
ownership: File references caller-owned immutable input, no upload; new selection means new content identity
WASM pointers remain owner-local; block outputs copied, sink must own/persist before acknowledgement
prepared package bytes and candidate session separate ownership records
prepared release blocked during load/validation; session copy or explicit lease survives handle disposal
release failures retain ownership and permit retry; disposal awaits cooperative operations
old session retired only after pinned run references end

cancellation.lora: cooperative at next bounded Hike return / async boundary; not instant Worker termination
cancellation.diffusion: existing API cancel terminates its owned Worker; separate acknowledgement
cancellation.manager: stop admission; invalidate snapshot attempt; request both sides, await terminal states; clean only own candidates
